payload.description_html: Remigolepis walkeri, dorsal (D1), lateral (D2), and ventral (D3) views, after Johanson (1997a). Abbreviations: CD1–4, plates of the dorsal central series; CV1, ventral central plate 1; DM1–4, plates of the dorso-medial marginal series; ML1–4, plates of the lateral marginal series; MM1–4, plates of the medial marginal series; VM1–3, plates of the ventro-medial marginal series.
